name: io.github.WYRE-AI/blackpoint-mcp
title: Blackpoint Cyber
description: MCP server for Blackpoint Cyber MDR — alerts, threats, and operations.

environmentVariables.name: BLACKPOINT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Blackpoint API base URL. Optional. Defaults to https://api.blackpointcyber.com/v1. A value with or without /v1, or the legacy api.compassone.blackpointcyber.com host, is normalized to that URL. Other hosts keep their origin and gain a single /v1 suffix.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode for the server. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Credential source: 'env' reads vars locally, 'gateway' expects header injection from the WYRE MCP Gateway.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
